## Purpose and deployment shape
BitChord is a native Android music client centered on YouTube Music, extensible stream sources, local media, downloads, rich playback, and synchronized listening. The Gradle Android app is the primary deliverable; a separate Python backend coordinates Listen Together parties. Android entry points are `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/BitChordApplication.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/MainActivity.kt`, and `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`.

## UI and application coordination
The Android app uses Kotlin UI layers organized around screens, reusable Compose-style components, and a shared view-model/foreground-state boundary. UI issues intents to playback, repositories, account flows, and settings; it observes player/media state for browsing and now-playing presentation. Key paths: `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/ui/MainViewModel.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/ui/screens/`, `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/ui/player/NowPlayingScreen.kt`.

## Catalog, identities, and stream-source resolution
Music metadata and playback candidates originate from YouTube Music/Innertube, device media, JioSaavn, and dynamically configured add-on or module sources. `SourceRegistry`/`SourceResolver` select and match a source, while Innertube resolves YouTube playback data and streams. This is the core provider boundary, isolating external APIs and QuickJS-backed module logic from playback. Paths: `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/data/sources/SourceRegistry.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/data/sources/SourceResolver.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/data/innertube/StreamResolver.kt`.

## Playback service and audio pipeline
`PlaybackService` is the long-lived foreground media-session owner: it controls queue lifecycle, stream choices, caching, routing, crossfades, quality changes, equalization, and party synchronization. UI and widgets connect through player-facing abstractions rather than owning audio directly. Audio data flows from resolved remote/local streams through cache/data-source and processors to Android output. Paths: `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/playback/PlaybackService.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/playback/AudioCache.kt`.

## Smart automix and native analysis
Automix analyzes tracks for beats, tempo, mel features, and vocals, persists analysis, then plans compatible transitions for playback. Kotlin orchestration crosses JNI into C++ signal-processing code; bundled quantized ONNX models support beat/vocal inference. This is a performance-critical Android/native boundary. Paths: `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/playback/smart/TrackAnalyzer.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/playback/smart/TransitionPlanner.kt`, `app/src/main/cpp/jni/analysis_jni.cpp`.

## Offline and enrichment subsystems
Downloads convert selected streams into persisted offline assets and apply container-specific media and lyric tags. Independently, lyrics aggregate embedded and provider sources, align word timing, and can translate; animated canvases are fetched/cached from several music services. Paths: `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/download/DownloadService.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/data/lyrics/LyricsRepository.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/data/canvas/CanvasRepository.kt`.

## Accounts and external integrations
Authentication/session state supports YouTube Music and Discord. Playback events can publish Discord presence, scrobble to Last.fm/ListenBrainz, record listening statistics, and synchronize party state. External dependencies include YouTube Music Innertube, Discord gateway/RPC, lyrics/canvas providers, Last.fm, ListenBrainz, and configured source endpoints. Paths: `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/auth/AccountSessions.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/data/discord/DiscordRPC.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/music/bitchord/data/scrobbling/ScrobbleManager.kt`.

## Listen Together backend
The Python backend exposes the party coordination protocol, invite/code handling, authoritative clock, and in-memory hub/party management used by Android’s Listen Together client. It is deployable via Render configuration and is distinct from media streaming: it coordinates members and timing rather than hosting music. Paths: `backend/app/main.py`, `backend/app/hub.py`, `backend/app/party.py`.
